## Summary
J. Shawaz is a Full-Stack Developer and Interactive Web Engineer specializing in building modern, high-performance web applications, 3D WebGL experiences, and smooth animated interfaces. He works extensively with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP, and Framer Motion.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend & Frameworks**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3
- **Styling & Design Systems**: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Responsive Design, Glassmorphic & Modern UI
- **Animations & 3D**: Three.js, React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei), GSAP, Framer Motion, Lenis Smooth Scroll
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, Nodemailer, Server Actions
- **Tools & Platforms**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, npm, ESLint, PostCSS

## Services Offered
- Full-Stack Web Application Engineering
- Custom Interactive 3D & WebGL Website Experiences
- Performant Motion Design & UI Animation Systems
- Web Performance Optimization & Next.js Architecture
